$comment: Every allowed audit finding lives here, with a reason, an owner and a review date. Source code references an entry by id: CSS uses /* audit-allow <id> */ on the line; stories that turn off an a11y rule carry // audit-exception: <id>. Entries past their review date show as warnings until re-reviewed. Changes need design-system review (CODEOWNERS).

exceptions.reason: Soar's drawer is 30rem wide, but Figma has no variable for drawer width yet. Replace with var(--ax-size-drawer) once design adds size/drawer.

wa-select's accessible name comes from the label ax-control-info passes in and matches the visible label exactly (WCAG 2.5.3). axe can't link a visible label outside wa-select's shadow root, so this best-practice rule misfires.

Web Awesome 3.14.0 renders unlabelled checkboxes inside wa-tree-item in multiple-selection mode. It's inside Web Awesome, so Soar doesn't patch it; selection state is exposed through the tree items. Re-check on every upstream bump.
